name: Orbital Age 2085
description: A fictional future, New Year 2085: Europe, East Africa, West Africa, South America and Arabia have merged into federations, Korea is one country again and a warmer world has redrawn where people live. Three blocs led by America, China and India hold each other in check with nuclear arsenals and orbital weapons, while their stations, asteroid miners and first settlements on the Moon and Mars make space the new frontier.
approximations: Entirely fictional: every merger, alliance, rivalry, technology level and event is invented to make a playable future, not a forecast. Borders are the 2026 provinces regrouped into the invented unions (the European Federation includes the 2026 EU, Ukraine, Moldova and the western Balkans; the federations of East and West Africa, South America and Arabia follow regional organisations; Greenland is independent and Korea reunified). Population and GDP are 2026 figures times rough growth multipliers that stand for demographic change and climate damage (shrinking East Asia and Europe, growing Africa and South Asia, weakened low-lying and very hot states). Forces, nuclear stockpiles and satellites are speculative. Space stations and off-world settlements are given to the space powers by opening events.
